meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a healthy server when available and linking to official server setup guidance when needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Mattermost 机器人接进聊天频道,复用可用服务器并给出搭建指引
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你团队用 Mattermost,想让机器人常驻聊天频道。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team runs Mattermost and wants a bot living in its channels.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会带你接入自建或云端 Mattermost 机器人频道:探测已有健康服务器、设置 SiteURL、安装适配器、创建并认证机器人,再构建、测试、重启并验证。支持私聊、频道、话题、文件和审批卡片。
howto.when: 当你要求把 Mattermost 接入为机器人频道时触发;它会先探测本机或 Docker 中的健康服务器,再让你选择使用它或另填一个 URL。

say.text: 帮我接入 Mattermost,先看看本机有没有可用的服务器。
say.note: 会探测 localhost:8065 等地址并请你确认。
会为该地址设置 SiteURL 并继续。

say.text: 检查一下 Mattermost 频道是否已经接通。
say.note: 会在机器人私聊里发一张临时诊断卡片。

howto.what_en: Claude adds a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel end to end: probe for a healthy server, set SiteURL, install the adapter, create and authenticate the bot, then build, test, restart, verify. Supports DMs and approval cards.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Mattermost as a bot channel; it probes for a healthy server on localhost or in Docker and asks you to pick it or enter another URL.

say_en.text: Add Mattermost; first check if there's a healthy server on this machine.
say_en.note: Probes localhost:8065 and asks you to confirm.
Sets SiteURL for that URL and continues setup.

say_en.text: Check whether the Mattermost channel is wired up.
say_en.note: Creates a temporary diagnostic card in the bot DM.
